newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico to limit bank deposit coverage - Ortiz.
newsitem.headline: Mexico to limit bank deposit coverage - Ortiz.

text.p: Mexican Finance Minister Guillermo Ortiz said on Friday banks must take greater responsibility for their own performance and the government would gradually limit depositor protection from next year.

"Within a framework in which the state has to protect and guarantee the resources of the least favored savers but not the survival of the institutions, from 1998 the coverage that (bank insurance fund) Fobaproa grants to depositors and other bank creditors will be gradually limited," Ortiz said.
He told the annual Mexican Bankers' Association Convention here that the banking sector had to "assume more responsibility" in its actions and encourage confidence.
Ortiz also said he expected banks, that were clobbered by Mexico's 1994-1995 economic crisis, to begin lending again soon.
"We expect that...in the second half of 1997 the flow of credit will rise gradually and the volume of business will increase significantly," he said.
